resources.string: A journal of where you go
Whereday keeps your location history on this phone. No account is needed to record your day.
Record routes, remember visits and make your history your own with saved places and notes.
Location access lets Whereday record a route while your screen is off. Choose precise location for useful routes. You can use the rest of the app without granting access.
An ongoing notification shows your recording status and lets you stop without opening the app. Allow notifications to keep these controls visible.
Start a recording whenever you are ready. You can change distance, auto-stop and appearance in Settings.
Recording continues with the screen off.
Start a recording to save your next outing.
Showing %1$d of %2$d points. Statistics use the full selected history.
Your route will appear here after the first accurate location fix. Recording does not require a network connection.
